claims.title: A fixed mixed-orientation profile improves the formal score and passes exact necessary screens
claims.origin: AI research directed by repository owner; coordinated agents in one generating session
claims.statement: The canonical (5,100,140) endpoints 10 Full(5,10) and 7 Full(5,2) + 10 Full(5,3) + 4 O(3,3) + 2 O(4,2) + 6 Mid(5,2) have a certified strict symmetric formal-score increase. They pass every ordinary Koszul degree on all three legs, both symmetric-power rank families in every degree, and all quantum and upper support bounds. Exact higher B-degree matrices and written all-degree source formulas complete the initial finite screens.
dependencies: DO01 through the existing common-input symmetric-power theorem
CVZ23 entropy definition and SDW26 Theorem1.1
Literal integer and rational controls in verify.py and verify_higher.py
Written source_b_koszul.md formula and source_c_koszul.md generic maximality theorem
Independent sufficient exterior-kernel and slice-cokernel controls in shadow_note.md
claims.limitations: Canonical target first bases for the computed B-leg ranks; the C-leg source theorem permits arbitrary targets of the same format. No actual tensor degeneration or improved exponent. Projected Koszul maps, other flattenings, and the border-rank condition remain outside this completed ordinary Koszul census. The initial report is retained as a historical checkpoint.

claims.title: Sharp maximal-rank windows on the output leg of identical convolution sums
claims.origin: AI research directed by repository owner
claims.statement: Over C, for S = c Full(a,b) and N = c(a+b−1), the output-leg Koszul map B* tensor wedge^p C -> A tensor wedge^(p+1) C is injective for p <= a−1 and surjective for p >= c(a−1). Explicit wedge kernels show that neither maximal-rank window extends beyond its stated boundary.
dependencies: Polynomial interpolation and elementary Vandermonde independence; both arguments written locally
claims.limitations: This elementary proof does not compute intervening ranks; the later source_c_koszul.md theorem does. No target construction. Complex field and positive integers a,b,c; degrees outside 0,...,N−1 omitted.

claims.title: The frozen target cannot be allocated whole-block-by-whole-block to individual source copies
claims.origin: AI research directed by repository owner; coordinating-agent deduction
claims.statement: The only nonnegative integer target-block count fitting the (10,14) long-leg dimensions of one source Full(5,10) is 2 Full(5,2) + Mid(5,2). Therefore the frozen global target cannot arise from a source-copy-preserving whole-block allocation on both long legs.
dependencies: Exact two-dimension equations and finite enumeration of 576 bounded tuples
claims.limitations: Only the stated copywise allocation class. Arbitrary linear mixing across source copies is not excluded.
